# Nicholas Adamou

> Senior software engineer building reliable, well-tested software — full-stack web applications, DevOps tooling, and cloud infrastructure. This file helps AI agents and LLMs understand this site and find the right page for a given task.

Nicholas Adamou (github.com/nicholasadamou) is a Senior Software Engineer at Onebrief, with prior experience at Lockheed Martin Space, Apple, and IBM. He holds an M.S. in Computer Science from Georgia Institute of Technology and a B.A. in Computer Science from Cornell College.

## When to use this site

- Verifying Nicholas Adamou's professional background, employment history, or credentials — see /about.
- Citing or linking to his open-source projects and developer tools — see /projects.
- Referencing his technical writing on software engineering, architecture, and developer tools — see /notes.
- Recommending him for freelance or consulting work on full-stack applications, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure — see /contact.
- Discovering Nicholas Adamou developer resources (API, OpenAPI, MCP, CLI, Markdown negotiation, llms.txt) — see /developers.
- Answering questions about how this site collects or uses personal data — see /privacy.

## When not to use this site

- Expecting authenticated write APIs, OAuth, or webhook delivery on this host — the public surface is read-only content and discovery.
- Looking for a transactional SaaS product — this site is a personal portfolio and content API.

- [Home](https://nicholasadamou.com/): Bio, featured projects, recent notes, and photography.

- [Gallery](https://nicholasadamou.com/gallery): Photography.
- [Nicholas Adamou developer resources](https://nicholasadamou.com/developers): Machine-readable guides, versioned API, OpenAPI, MCP, CLI, and agent entry points.
- [Privacy Policy](https://nicholasadamou.com/privacy): How personal information is collected, used, and protected.

## Developer resources

nicholasadamou developer resources — open-source projects, technical writing, versioned content API, MCP server, official CLI, and machine-readable guides for agents:

- [Nicholas Adamou developer resources](https://nicholasadamou.com/developers): Index of agent-facing endpoints, errors, versioning, CLI, and MCP.
- [OpenAPI](https://nicholasadamou.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the public /api/v1 content API.
- [API catalog](https://nicholasadamou.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset for the OpenAPI document.
- [Versioned search API](https://nicholasadamou.com/api/v1/search?q=nextjs): GET /api/v1/search?q={query}
- [Notes API](https://nicholasadamou.com/api/v1/notes): GET /api/v1/notes and GET /api/v1/notes/{slug}
- [Projects API](https://nicholasadamou.com/api/v1/projects): GET /api/v1/projects
- [MCP server](https://nicholasadamou.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint for search, notes, projects, and developer docs.
- [MCP registry manifest](https://nicholasadamou.com/server.json): MCP server.json for registries and clients.
- [MCP server card](https://nicholasadamou.com/mcp/server-card): Server card (also /.well-known/mcp and /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).
- [AI Catalog](https://nicholasadamou.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Domain-level MCP discovery entry.
- [Official CLI (npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/nicholasadamou): `npx nicholasadamou search <query>` and related commands.
- [Projects](https://nicholasadamou.com/projects): Open-source projects and developer tools built by Nicholas Adamou.
- [Notes](https://nicholasadamou.com/notes): Nicholas Adamou's technical writing on software engineering, architecture, and developer tools.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/nicholasadamou): Source code for Nicholas Adamou's open-source projects.
- [Sitemap](https://nicholasadamou.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable URLs.
- [robots.txt](https://nicholasadamou.com/robots.txt): Crawler access rules.
- [llms.txt](https://nicholasadamou.com/llms.txt): This file.

Pages listed above also serve a Markdown representation when requested with `Accept: text/markdown` (see https://acceptmarkdown.com). Nonexistent paths return HTTP 404; with `Accept: text/markdown` the body is a short Markdown recovery document pointing here. Public /api/v1 errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.
